Thought: I need to calculate the energy content of the snack and convert it to dietary calories.

Step 1: Calculate the energy released when burning the 2.0 g sample.
Energy = mass of water × specific heat capacity × temperature change
Energy = 500 g × 4.18 J/(K·g) × 20.9 K
Energy = 43,681 J = 43.681 kJ

Step 2: Convert this energy to dietary calories.
Dietary calories = Energy in kJ × 0.239
Dietary calories = 43.681 kJ × 0.239 = 10.44 dietary calories

Step 3: This is for a 2.0 g sample. Calculate for the standard 22 g bag.
Dietary calories in 22 g = (10.44 dietary calories / 2.0 g) × 22 g
Dietary calories in 22 g = 10.44 × 11 = 114.84 dietary calories
Final Answer: [ANSWER]114.84[/ANSWER]
